items.promptText: What does the employer contribute on the first tier, when the worker contributes 3% of pay?
What does the employer contribute on the second tier, when the worker contributes the next 2% of pay?
What is the largest employer contribution available in a year?
What must the worker contribute across the year to reach the full 5% of pay?
The employer contribution measured against the worker’s own $2,640.00 is what percentage, to two decimal places?
A worker raises their contribution from 5% of pay to 8%. Does the employer contribution rise?
A worker who contributes only 3% of pay leaves how much of the employer contribution unclaimed?
